# Week 4 Monday Briefing -- league-2 (Intuitech Fantasy)

**The week is effectively closed.** 15 of 16 Week 4 games are final. The only game left is tonight's ATL @ NO (Mon 10/5, 8:15pm ET) -- and it happens to be the one game with two of this roster's own starters on opposite sidelines: Tyler Shough (QB, NO) and Drake London (WR, ATL). Both are clean on the injury report and both stay in. Everything else below is confirmation, not a decision.

## Source and freshness

Primary source: the committed `weekly-report-week-4.json` fixture (FantasyPros consensus + ESPN injuries, generated 2026-10-04T16:43:15Z). Live overlay: `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` for Week 4 (318 rows, all 32 teams) shows **zero designation changes** versus the fixture for any rostered player. Also pulled `load_player_stats`/`load_team_stats` for the 9 already-decided starters to confirm actual box scores (not used to re-project anything -- the game already happened). ESPN, Sleeper, Rotowire and FantasyPros are all proxy-blocked in this sandbox; the fixture's own CI build already has real ESPN injuries and FantasyPros consensus baked in, so the live check here is purely confirmatory.

## Start these ten (Week 4, mostly already locked)

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | P(play) | If-he-plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Tyler Shough | vs ATL (tonight) | 18.40 | 96.2% | 19.13 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | @WAS -- FINAL (IND 30-13) | 21.13 | 96.8% | 21.83 |
| RB | Cam Skattebo | vs ARI -- FINAL (NYG 36-24) | 14.54 | 94.0% | 15.47 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | vs LAC -- FINAL (SEA 30-23) | 21.83 | 95.9% | 22.76 |
| WR | Drake London | @NO (tonight) | 15.86 | 95.9% | 16.53 |
| TE | Isaiah Likely | vs ARI -- FINAL (NYG 36-24) | 10.63 | 93.4% | 11.38 |
| FLEX | Tee Higgins | vs JAX -- FINAL (JAX 22-17) | 15.85 | 95.9% | 16.52 |
| FLEX | Bucky Irving | vs GB -- FINAL (GB 17-14) | 13.91 | 96.8% | 14.37 |
| K | Cameron Dicker | @SEA -- FINAL (SEA 30-23) | 7.51 | 98.1% | 7.65 |
| DEF | Eagles D/ST | vs LA -- FINAL (LA 24-20) | 3.86 | 100% | 3.86 |
| **Total** | | | **143.52** | | |

**Bench (not started):** Matthew Stafford (QB), Matthew Golden (WR), Jameson Williams (WR), TreVeyon Henderson (RB), Jalen Coker (WR, Questionable -- quad). **IR:** Jaxson Dart (QB, season-ending knee surgery).

## Changes since the last briefing (Sat 10/3)

- **Shough in for Stafford at QB** (+2.95 expected points), executed by the owner 2026-10-04 on three straight 22-24 point starts and a 18.40 vs 15.45 projection edge.
- **Trade landed:** sent Josh Downs + Brock Bowers, received TreVeyon Henderson (RB, NE) + Jalen Coker (WR, CAR). Likely takes the TE slot back from Bowers as a consequence, not a fresh start/sit call.
- Everything else in the lineup is unchanged from Saturday.

## Results so far (context, not a decision)

- **Taylor:** 24 carries, 95 yards, 2 TD -- as advertised.
- **Skattebo:** 58 rush, 1 catch/8 -- quiet in a blowout win; watch next week's touch split.
- **Smith-Njigba:** 5/76 -- locked-in WR1 production.
- **Likely:** 7 catches on 12 targets for 66 -- the target share is the signal.
- **Higgins:** 11 catches, **157 yards** -- way over projection, in a loss.
- **Irving:** 61 rush, 0 catches -- under projection in a close loss.
- **Dicker:** 3/3 FG (long 40), 2/2 PAT -- clean.
- **Eagles D/ST:** 1 sack, 2 INT, allowed 24 -- roughly on plan.
- **Shough & London:** both play tonight, against each other.

## Watch list

- **Jalen Coker** (WR, CAR) -- Questionable, quad, limited practice all week, unchanged from the fixture. Just traded for; currently buried on the bench. Final Week 5 practice reports land by Friday 10/9.

## Opponent notes

- Tonight's ATL @ NO is the only live game left and it's a two-for-one for this roster: a high-scoring game helps both Shough and London, a defensive grind caps both.
- Carolina (Coker's team) byes Week 5 -- he may not get a usable week on this roster before that bye even clears.

## Byes ahead (next two weeks)

- **Week 5:** Jalen Coker (CAR).
- **Week 6:** Tee Higgins (CIN) **and** Jameson Williams (DET) -- both at once. That's the current FLEX starter and the best bench WR body out simultaneously, with only Matthew Golden left standing at the position. **This needs a waiver add now, not in two weeks.**

## Waiver planning for the Week 6 WR crunch

Degraded sandbox run (in-house estimate tier only, no FantasyPros/Rotowire, no visibility into the other 7 rosters in this league -- treat as names to check on the waiver wire, not a ranked board): **Adonai Mitchell** (NYJ), **Denzel Boston** (CLE), and at RB, **Tyler Allgeier** (ARI) as a depth flyer. Worth a priority claim before Wednesday if any are actually available in this league.

## Caveats

- No live ESPN/Sleeper/Rotowire/FantasyPros access this run; fixture + live-injury overlay only, both agreeing.
- Lineup total (143.52) sits at the high end of the normal band on the strength of two legitimate elite-week projections (Taylor, Smith-Njigba) -- checked, not a pipeline failure like the 2026-09-21/23 incidents.
- Waiver names are unverified against this league's actual rosters (out of scope for this tool) -- confirm availability before claiming.
